_help: Per-player corrections for scripts/syncPlayerImages.ts, keyed by player id (see player-image-review.html).
iplName: the player's name as spelled on iplt20.com squad pages.
wikipedia: the exact English Wikipedia article title to use.
commonsFile: a specific Wikimedia Commons file name to use (e.g. 'Dasun Shanaka in 2022.jpg').
skipIpl / skipWikipedia: true = that source gave a wrong photo, don't use it.
name: for humans only; the script ignores it.
To use your own photo instead, drop it in player-photos/ named after the player (e.g. 'Virat Kohli.jpg') or their id ('p-1.png').
